name: search_symptoms
description: Search for possible conditions based on reported symptoms

duration.description: How long symptoms have been present

returns: List of possible conditions ranked by likelihood with descriptions and recommended actions

name: find_doctors
description: Search for doctors or healthcare providers by specialty and location

accepting_new_patients.description: Only show doctors accepting new patients

returns: List of doctors with name, specialty, rating, address, availability, and insurance accepted

name: get_doctor_details
description: Get detailed information about a specific healthcare provider
returns: Full profile with credentials, specialties, education, office hours, accepted insurance, languages, and patient reviews

name: book_appointment
description: Book a medical appointment with a healthcare provider
returns: Appointment confirmation with appointment_id, date, time, location, and preparation instructions

name: cancel_appointment
description: Cancel an existing medical appointment
returns: Cancellation confirmation and any applicable cancellation fee

name: reschedule_appointment
description: Reschedule an existing medical appointment to a new date/time
returns: Updated appointment confirmation with new date, time, and any changes

name: get_appointment_details
description: Retrieve details of an existing appointment
returns: Full appointment details including doctor, date, time, location, visit type, and preparation instructions

name: list_appointments
description: List all upcoming and past appointments
returns: List of appointments with doctor, date, time, type, and status

name: check_doctor_availability
description: Check available appointment slots for a specific doctor
returns: List of available time slots with duration and visit type

name: search_medications
description: Search for medication information by name or condition

query.description: Medication name or condition to treat

returns: Medication details with name, dosage, side effects, interactions, and pricing

name: check_drug_interactions
description: Check for potential interactions between medications

medications.description: List of medication names to check interactions between

returns: Interaction report with severity levels, descriptions, and recommendations

name: get_prescription_details
description: Get details of an active prescription
returns: Prescription details including medication, dosage, frequency, refills remaining, and prescribing doctor

name: request_prescription_refill
description: Request a refill for an existing prescription
returns: Refill request confirmation with estimated ready date and pharmacy details

name: list_prescriptions
description: List all active and past prescriptions for the patient
returns: List of prescriptions with medication name, dosage, frequency, prescriber, and refill status

name: get_lab_results
description: Retrieve lab test results
returns: Lab results with test names, values, reference ranges, and abnormal flags

name: get_medical_records
description: Retrieve medical records and health history
returns: Medical records with dates, providers, diagnoses, notes, and attached documents

name: find_pharmacies
description: Find nearby pharmacies with hours and services
returns: List of pharmacies with name, address, hours, phone, services, and distance

name: compare_medication_prices
description: Compare prices for a medication across pharmacies

insurance_id.description: Insurance member ID for copay estimates

returns: Price comparison across pharmacies with and without insurance, generic alternatives

name: log_vital_signs
description: Log vital sign measurements for health tracking
returns: Logged measurement with comparison to normal ranges and trend

name: get_vital_signs_history
description: Retrieve historical vital sign measurements
returns: Historical measurements with dates, values, trends, and alerts for abnormal readings

name: get_insurance_coverage
description: Check insurance coverage for a specific procedure, medication, or service

provider_id.description: Doctor or facility ID to check in-network status

returns: Coverage details including copay, coinsurance, deductible status, prior authorization requirements, and in-network status

name: get_immunization_records
description: Retrieve immunization/vaccination records
returns: List of immunizations with vaccine name, date administered, provider, and due dates for upcoming vaccines

name: schedule_vaccination
description: Schedule a vaccination appointment
returns: Vaccination appointment confirmation with location, date, cost, and what to bring

name: get_health_summary
description: Get a comprehensive health summary for the patient
returns: Comprehensive health summary with active conditions, current medications, allergies, recent vitals, and upcoming appointments

name: update_allergies
description: Add, update, or remove allergy information from the patient record
returns: Updated allergy list with confirmation of changes

name: find_urgent_care
description: Find nearby urgent care facilities or emergency rooms
returns: List of nearby facilities with address, hours, wait time, services, and insurance acceptance

name: get_care_instructions
description: Get post-visit care instructions for a condition or procedure

visit_id.description: Visit ID for specific care instructions

returns: Care instructions including medications, activity restrictions, follow-up schedule, and warning signs to watch for

name: message_doctor
description: Send a secure message to a healthcare provider

attachments.description: File paths to attach (e.g., photos of symptoms)

returns: Message sent confirmation with expected response time

name: get_exercise_recommendations
description: Get personalized exercise recommendations based on health profile
returns: Personalized exercise plan with recommended activities, duration, frequency, and safety precautions

name: calculate_bmi
description: Calculate Body Mass Index and provide health assessment
returns: BMI value, category (underweight/normal/overweight/obese), and health recommendations

name: set_medication_reminder
description: Set up a reminder to take medication
returns: Reminder setup confirmation with schedule details

name: estimate_medical_cost
description: Estimate out-of-pocket costs for a medical procedure or visit
returns: Cost estimate with facility price range, insurance coverage, estimated copay, and payment options
